Description: Fallback Strategy 3 decoded base64url JWT payloads without verifying cryptographic signatures, allowing attackers to forge arbitrary user IDs and admin privileges.
Remediation_Details: Removed unverified fallback. All authentication tokens must now be cryptographically validated via Google JWKS or Google OAuth2 tokeninfo API endpoint.

Vulnerability_Title: Unverified Voucher Token Prefix Extraction Bypass
Description: Extracted userId by simply stripping the cursis_usr_ prefix from user-provided token string without verifying the HMAC signature, allowing unauthenticated token forgery.
Remediation_Details: Replaced raw string manipulation with verifySessionToken() cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verification.

Vulnerability_Title: Client-Side Cookie Write Stripping HttpOnly Flag
Description: Client-side document.cookie writes for cursis_session overwrote the server-side HttpOnly cookie with a non-HttpOnly version, exposing authentication tokens to XSS attacks.
Remediation_Details: Removed client-side document.cookie writes for session cookies. Session cookie is now strictly managed server-side with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Lax flags.

Description: Signup route allowed 6-character passwords without uppercase, lowercase, numeric, or special character requirements, susceptible to dictionary and brute-force attacks.
Remediation_Details: Enforced minimum 8-character length and mandatory uppercase, lowercase, numeric, and special character complexity checks.

Vulnerability_Title: Rate Limiter Fail-Open on Database Outage
Description: When MongoDB was disconnected or unavailable, rate limiter returned allowed=true, disabling brute-force protections during database connectivity hiccups.
Remediation_Details: Implemented in-memory fallback rate limiter that activates automatically when MongoDB is unavailable, maintaining rate limits (5 attempts / 30 mins) under all conditions.

Description: Password hashing utilized only 10,000 iterations of PBKDF2-SHA512. OWASP recommends at least 600,000 iterations for PBKDF2-SHA512.
Remediation_Details: Increased default PBKDF2 iterations to 600,000 with backwards-compatible dual-verification support for existing users.

Description: Redirect parameter only verified startsWith('/'), enabling open redirect attacks via protocol-relative URLs (e.g., //attacker.com) or backslash evasion (/\\attacker.com).
Remediation_Details: Implemented getSafeRelativeRedirect() ensuring destination strictly starts with single slash, blocks //, /\\, backslashes, CRLF, and null bytes.

Description: WAF only checked raw URL strings without decoding URL encoding, permitting evasion via URL-encoded traversal (%2e%2e), CRLF injection (%0d%0a), and script tags/event handlers.
Remediation_Details: Added safe URI decoding and expanded WAF detection for traversal variants, null bytes, CRLF, script/iframe/object tags, javascript: schemes, event handlers, and OS files.

Vulnerability_Title: Error Message Information Disclosure in API Responses
Description: Unsanitized 500 error responses returned raw error.message values, risking disclosure of database connection strings, credentials, and internal exceptions.
Remediation_Details: Updated apiError to sanitize 500 responses in production, redacting MongoDB connection URIs, credentials, tokens, and internal error strings.

Description: Absence of Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy headers permitted potential cross-origin document leaks and side-channel attacks.
Remediation_Details: Configured Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin in both next.config.ts and Edge proxy headers.

Vulnerability_Title: React Strict Mode Disabled in Production Configuration
Description: reactStrictMode was set to false, disabling React lifecycle safety warnings, component side-effect detection, and deprecation checks.

Vulnerability_Title: Anonymous Promo Code Redemption & Rate Limit Absence
Description: Promo code endpoint allowed anonymous callers to permanently burn single-use vouchers, and lacked IP rate limiting allowing code brute-forcing.
Remediation_Details: Enforced mandatory user authentication prior to voucher consumption and added IP-based rate limiting to prevent brute-force attacks.

Vulnerability_Title: Unredacted Database Connection URI in Error Handling
Description: In db-status endpoint, database connection error objects could echo connection string credentials if MongoDB driver threw connection failures.
Remediation_Details: Added regex redaction in db-status error handler to strip username:password credentials and redact MongoDB URIs.
